chapter: Hurry On Down, Capitol and New York
title: Reel 5: composer royalties and The Lady's in Love
summary: After the reel change she confirms writer royalties on Hurry On Down and that The Lady's in Love, a Frank Loesser tune, was its B side.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

P R O C E E D I N G S
When the other reel ran out, you were talking about, "Hurry on Down," and you said since you wrote it, you got what, composer royalties?
From the beginning, through the publisher.
I see. And there was another -- "The Lady's in Love With You," did rather well too, didn't it?
Well, that was Loesser, Frank Loesser's tune. That was the B side of --
Oh, that was on the other side of, "Hurry On Down."
I see. I remember hearing it a lot.
And do you know how many copies, "Hurry On Down," sold?
